svg.text: Choptuik echo period Δ(D) and critical exponent γ(D) of massless scalar collapse
One rational formula in 1/(D−2) for all D ≥ 4, fitted on the computed points 4 ≤ D ≤ 30.2; the 8 hollow points above are held out and match it to 2e-06,
and the double-double points (green) up to D = 61 to 6e-08. Δ∞ = 1.64389375 from the double-double points, γ∞ = 1/2
Δ levels off at Δ∞ ≈ 1.6439 instead of falling to zero
